statement_scope: Whole original Problem21.75: for distinct sets P1,P2 of odd primes with neither contained in the other, ask whether <CT_{P1}(Z),CT_{P2}(Z)> is a proper subgroup of CT_{P1 union P2}(Z). CT_P(Z) is generated by class transpositions of disjoint residue classes whose moduli have prime divisors only in P union {2}, as defined in original17.57/17.60. Iskra proves equality for arbitrary sets P1,P2 of odd primes (Theorem5.2), thus answering the full original strictness question negatively. The stronger arbitrary-set form remains part of this one solution; it is not a separately counted task.
